main_text.p: figam eum ueluti clauum in loco fideli, & erit in folium gloriae domus patris sui. Et suspendent super ipsum omnem gloriam domus patris sui, stirpes & posteritates, omnia uasa minora, à uasis craterum usque ad uniuersa uasa melodiarum. In die illa, dicit Dominus exercituum, recedet clauus fixus in loco fideli, frangetur & cadet, & dissipabitur onus quod fuit superipsum, quoniam Dominus loquutus est.
main_text.head: ANNOTATIONES.
main_text.p: ONVS uallis uisionis.) Nonus locus, in quo uaticinatur propheta contra Ierusalem, quam placuit ei noua quadam ratione Vallem uisionis appellare. Ac Visionis quidem, tum quod in ea magis quàm alibi uisiones tam huic prophetae, quàm multis alijs manifestatae fuerint, tum quod frequentissimi prophetae, qui aliàs dicti Videntes, ea incoluerint: Vallem uero per μ[?]ωσιν[?], & quasi cum sarcasmo, quod uidelicet quae simul naturali situ magna ex parte in monte sita erat, simul dignitate facile anteibat ciuitates omnes reliquas, propediè foret humiliada, & quodammodo ex monte in uallem redigenda. Diuiditur autem hic locus siue concio in duas partes: quarum priore uaticinatur generaliter contra uniuersam ciuitatem, posteriore uero speciatim contra illustrem ac potente in aula Regis Ezechiae uirum Sebna, domui regiae praefectum, cuius

page.notes: The Greek word after "per" is doubtful; the printed letters are not clear enough to read with confidence, so the whole word is marked [?]. The printer's mark before "cuiusq;" at the lower right is not clear and is not transcribed. Italic was judged from the scan and may not be exact at the edges. The "ꝑ"-like sign and the abbreviation "cuiusq;" are transcribed as they appear. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
